item.title: Tottori Leisure Guide: Sandboarding, Pear Picking & Coastal Adventures
item.description: Tottori is not a prefecture you pass through — it’s one you come to for specific, memorable experiences. The sand dunes alone justify the trip, but layer in paragliding, sea caves, pear orchards, and a world-class sculpture exhibition made entirely of sand, and a single weekend barely scratches the surface. This guide covers Tottori’s best leisure activities in practical detail, with logistics to help you plan each one. Sandboarding and Sand Skiing at Tottori Dunes Japan’s largest sand dunes stretch 16 km along the San’in coast, rising up to 47 meters.
